get_hotspot.description: Look up a Helium Hotspot by its address: its name, which networks it's on, where it is, and its antenna details. No API key required.
get_hotspot.name: get_hotspot

parameters.description: The Hotspot's Helium address, as the Helium Wallet app or an explorer shows it. Its Solana key or a link to its explorer page work too.
parameters.name: hotspot

hotspot.description: The Hotspot and where it is.

asset_id.description: The id of the Hotspot's NFT on Solana.

city.description: The city the Hotspot is in, from its IoT or Mobile location.

hotspot_address.description: The Hotspot's Helium address, as the Helium Wallet app and explorers show it. Get a hotspot takes this.

hotspot_key.description: The Hotspot's key on Solana (its key-to-asset account). Get a hotspot accepts this too.

image_url.description: The picture Helium shows for the Hotspot's NFT.

iot_added_at.description: When the Hotspot was added to the IoT Network (ISO 8601).

iot_antenna_gain_dbi.description: The antenna's gain in dBi, as asserted, e.g. 1.2.

iot_city.description: The city of its IoT location.

iot_country.description: The country of its IoT location.

iot_elevation_m.description: The antenna's height above ground, in metres, as asserted.

iot_latitude.description: Approximate latitude of its IoT location.

iot_longitude.description: Approximate longitude of its IoT location.

iot_state.description: The state of its IoT location.

iot_street.description: The street of its IoT Network location, when known.

is_rewardable.description: True when the Hotspot can earn rewards.

latitude.description: Approximate latitude. Helium blurs locations to roughly a neighbourhood for the owner's privacy.

mobile_added_at.description: When the Hotspot was added to the Mobile Network (ISO 8601).

mobile_city.description: The city of its Mobile location.

mobile_country.description: The country of its Mobile location.

mobile_device_type.description: The kind of Mobile Hotspot: CBRS radio, Wi-Fi indoor, Wi-Fi outdoor or Wi-Fi data only.

mobile_latitude.description: Approximate latitude of its Mobile location.

mobile_longitude.description: Approximate longitude of its Mobile location.

mobile_state.description: The state of its Mobile location.

mobile_street.description: The street of its Mobile Network location, when known.

name.description: The Hotspot's three-word name, e.g. Long Orchid Skunk. Helium generates it from the address, so it never changes.

network_names.description: The networks as one line, e.g. IoT, Mobile.

networks.description: The networks the Hotspot is on: iot, mobile or both. Empty when it hasn't been set up on either yet.

get_network_stats.description: Get how many Hotspots are on Helium's IoT Network and on its Mobile Network, to track the network's growth over time. No API key required.
get_network_stats.display_str_template: Count the Hotspots on the Helium network.
get_network_stats.name: get_network_stats

get_organization.description: Look up one organization on Helium's IoT Network by its number (OUI): who owns it, who pays for its traffic, and whether its routing is locked. No API key required.
get_organization.name: get_organization

parameters.description: The organization's number, called an OUI. Pick it from the list or type it.
parameters.name: oui

organization.description: An organization that routes LoRaWAN device traffic.

delegate_count.description: How many delegate addresses it has.

delegate_keys.description: Addresses allowed to manage the organization's routing.

escrow.description: The Solana account that holds its Data Credit escrow.

is_locked.description: True when its routing is locked, so device traffic isn't delivered; usually because its Data Credits ran out.

oui.description: The organization's number (OUI), e.g. 1. Get a LoRaWAN organization takes this.

owner.description: The Helium address that owns the organization.

payer.description: The address that pays Data Credits for its device traffic.

get_wallet.description: See every Hotspot a Helium wallet owns and how much HNT, MOBILE, IOT and Data Credits it holds. Use it to keep an eye on your fleet or your earnings. No API key required.
get_wallet.display_name: Get a wallet's hotspots and balances
get_wallet.display_str_template: Get the Hotspots and balances of wallet {0}.
get_wallet.name: get_wallet

parameters.description: The wallet's Solana address, from the Helium Wallet app: 32 to 44 letters and numbers.
parameters.name: wallet

parameters.description: Optional. The most Hotspots to include, between 1 and 500; 100 by default. The Hotspot count always covers all of them.
parameters.name: limit

get_wallet.result_str_template: The wallet owns {helium_get_wallet,hotspot_count} Hotspots and holds {helium_get_wallet,hnt_balance} HNT.

data_credits.description: The wallet's Data Credits, which pay for sending data over the network.

hnt_balance.description: The wallet's HNT, Helium's main token.

hotspot_count.description: How many Hotspots the wallet owns in total.

hotspots.description: The wallet's Hotspots, up to the limit.

hotspot_key.description: The Hotspot's key on Solana (its key-to-asset account). Get a hotspot accepts this too.

image_url.description: The picture Helium shows for the Hotspot's NFT.

iot_country.description: The country of its IoT location.

iot_latitude.description: Approximate latitude of its IoT location.

iot_street.description: The street of its IoT Network location, when known.

is_rewardable.description: True when the Hotspot can earn rewards.

mobile_city.description: The city of its Mobile location.

mobile_state.description: The state of its Mobile location.

network_names.description: The networks as one line, e.g. IoT, Mobile.

networks.description: The networks the Hotspot is on: iot, mobile or both. Empty when it hasn't been set up on either yet.

hotspots_returned.description: How many Hotspots are in the list.

wallet_address.description: The wallet address that was looked up.

list_hotspots.description: List the Hotspots on the IoT or Mobile network, a page at a time, with each one's address and approximate location. No API key required.
list_hotspots.name: list_hotspots

parameters.description: Optional. How many Hotspots to return, between 1 and 1000; 100 by default.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional. Leave empty for the first page. To get the next one, pass the next page token from the previous List hotspots step.
parameters.name: page_token

count.description: How many Hotspots are in this page.

has_more.description: True when there are more pages.

hotspot_address.description: The Hotspot's Helium address, as the Helium Wallet app and explorers show it. Get a hotspot takes this.

hotspot_key.description: The Hotspot's key on Solana (its key-to-asset account). Get a hotspot accepts this too.

latitude.description: Approximate latitude. Helium blurs locations to roughly a neighbourhood for the owner's privacy.

network.description: The network that was listed: iot or mobile.

next_page_token.description: Pass this as Next page to get the following page. Empty on the last page.

list_organizations.description: List the organizations that route LoRaWAN device data over Helium's IoT Network, each with its number (OUI) and whether its routing is locked. No API key required.

description: Look up Hotspots on the Helium wireless network: where a Hotspot is, which networks it serves and its antenna details. See every Hotspot a wallet owns along with its HNT, MOBILE, IOT and Data Credit balances, count the Hotspots on the IoT and Mobile networks, list them page by page, and look up the organizations that route LoRaWAN traffic. Uses Helium's own free Entity API. No account or API key required.
